headline: Red Sox steal a gritty extra-innings victory against the Mets
morning_brew: That win at Citi Field was a cardiac event that I honestly didn't need, but it sure as hell beats losing. We grinded out ten innings and somehow walked away with the W, even if our offense was scuffling to find much rhythm at the plate all night. Payton Tolle went out there and gave us everything he had before handing it off, and I will take a hard-fought win over a pretty one any day of the week when we are playing on the road.

Aroldis Chapman came in and did the job to earn the win, and watching Garrett Whitlock slam the door shut in the tenth was the kind of relief that only a Red Sox fan can truly appreciate. It wasn't the offensive explosion we saw earlier this week, but when you are fighting for every base and getting timely outs from the bullpen, you stay in the fight. I am just happy we didn't end up on the wrong side of a close one for a change.

We finally get to head home to Fenway soon to host Tampa Bay, and I am counting the minutes until we get back to our own yard. I know we have more work to do to keep this momentum rolling, but for tonight, I am just gonna sit back and enjoy a win that honestly felt like it took five years off my life. Maybe my neighbor Rick will finally find something else to complain about besides the strike zone now that we have put a couple of tallies in the win column.

trend_watch.trend: Securing key wins out of the pen
trend_watch.dans_take: He showed real poise keeping the game locked down when we absolutely had to hold the line, and that is all I ask.
He is better than what we saw tonight, and I trust he will be back to driving the ball soon, before I lose my mind.
